_comment: Copy to config.json next to server.py and restart the web-search MCP (projects/tools/restart_svc.ps1 -Name websearch). Without config.json the server uses 'ddgs'.

_providers.ddgs: default, no key needed - general web search through DDGS (pip install ddgs); supports domains, recency_days, region and search_type=news
_providers.builtin: limited mode - Wikipedia + DuckDuckGo Instant Answer only, not a general web search; switches to Brave automatically when C:\LLM\secrets\brave-search.key exists
_providers.brave: Brave Search API (free tier available): put the key in api_key or in C:\LLM\secrets\brave-search.key
_providers.tavily: Tavily API key (built for LLM use)
_providers.searxng: your own SearXNG instance: set url instead of api_key
